messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn sky, full moon's glow, and the sound of jazz
An overcast but mild autumn day arrives with a nearly full moon. Consider local music and arts events in Ann Arbor and Detroit, or explore a science finding about autonomous navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 69°F and a low around 45°F, with a negligible chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, under a nearly full moon, 97.6% illuminated.
Evening attractions in nearby cities

The Ann Arbor District Library hosts Dolly Day with crafts and concert videos starting at 5:30 PM. For music lovers, pianist Barron Ryan offers a blend of classical and cool jazz at Kerrytown Concert House at 6:30 PM.
The next notable calendar item is the Autumn equilux, occurring just after midnight tomorrow.
University of Michigan advances cancer research with soundwave technology

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to develop non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves. This technique, already FDA-approved for liver tumors, offers a new approach to breaking apart tumors.
Tomorrow brings community and music events

Tomorrow, Ypsilanti kicks off The Big Read at 11 AM on the library plaza, and Spinning Dot Theatre presents 'Mariposa/Butterfly' at 2 PM. In Detroit, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum hosts 'Dossin After-Dark' this evening.
Satellites achieve GPS-free navigation

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated autonomous navigation without GPS, using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review.
The next estimated Starship launch is not officially scheduled, with independent estimates placing it no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Seek out the quiet hum of discovery in the day's offerings.
